strategy: Before investing time, be honest about the specialized experience: unless your IEM work included test/exercise program oversight with budget and contract duties, you likely won't qualify and should prioritize other postings.

If you did manage exercises (for example, HSEEP-style preparedness exercises), schedules, budgets or contract deliverables at IEM, frame that as test and exercise planning, program oversight and contractual guidance, using the posting's exact phrases.
On a 2-page resume, give each job start and end dates (month and year), hours per week, and concise bullets that mirror the duties and keywords.
Follow the flyer's 'How to Apply' directions exactly within the October 30 to November 9 window, because applications sent through the flyer itself are not accepted and you will get no result letter.
Treat this posting as a signal and target Navy, FEMA or DHS program analyst roles at GS-9/11, where your emergency-management and stakeholder strengths match better.
